Kipawa Road disruption

November 26, 2024

Please note that Kipawa Road is currently closed this morning near Restoroute due to a damaged utility pole. Authorities are awaiting intervention from Hydro-Québec to make the repairs.

We advise you to plan your travels accordingly and opt for an alternative route, Highway 101.

Thank you for your understanding.

  • Interactive work map

Concerned with providing a high quality of life for its residents, the Town of Temiscaming undertakes annual projects to improve its infrastructure, parks, and various public facilities. These efforts aim to enhance the comfort and safety of citizens while contributing to the beautification of the community. Whether it's through the development of new green spaces, the renovation of streets, or the modernization of sports and recreational facilities, the Town is committed to meeting the growing needs of its population and fostering a dynamic and pleasant environment for all.

Consent to cookies

This Website uses cookies for its proper functioning and to analyze your interaction with it, in order to offer you a personalized and improved experience. We will only use cookies if you give your consent by clicking “Accept all”. You also have the option to manage your cookie preferences by accessing the settings via the “Personalize” button.

For more information, read our Privacy Policy.

Personalization of cookies

Necessary (required)

Necessary cookies are crucial to the basic functions of the website and the website will not function as intended without them. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable data.

Name Domain Expiry Description
Cookies www.temiscaming.net 1 year Cookie that records your consent to cookies.
Google Maps www.temiscaming.net, *.google.com 1 month This cookie is crucial for the proper functioning of Google Maps, ensuring a smooth and efficient map navigation experience for users.
Google Fonts fonts.googleapis.com, fonts.gstatic.com 1 year Cookie for the operation of Google Fonts fonts.
Font Awesome *.fontawesome.com 1 year Cookie for the operation of Font Awesome icons.
Analytics

Analytical cookies are used to understand how visitors interact with the website. These cookies help provide information on metrics such as number of visitors, bounce rate, traffic source, etc.

Name Domain Expiry Description
Google Analytics www.temiscaming.net, *.google-analytics.com 2 years, 24 hours This cookie is used to collect website statistics and track conversion rates and user navigation on the site.
Advertising

Advertising cookies are used to provide visitors with relevant advertisements and marketing campaigns. These cookies track visitors across websites and collect information to provide personalized advertisements.
